read.thesis: Carrier's Q1 beat was driven by CSA Resi and Light Commercial, with field inventories down 35% and total orders up 11%, but FY guide was only reaffirmed and the 2% extra pricing is largely tariff-driven.

triggers.label: CSA field inventory down 35% YoY
triggers.quote: field inventory levels are very, very healthy. They ended the quarter, as Patrick said, down 35%
triggers.highlight: field inventory levels are very, very healthy

triggers.label: Company orders up 11%, CHVAC up 35%
triggers.quote: Company orders in 1Q were up 11% led by global CHVAC up 35%

triggers.label: Extra 2 pts global pricing, ~75% tariff-linked
triggers.quote: Of the 2 points of price that we are realizing or expect to realize for the year to increase -- to offset increased input costs, think about 75% of that related to tariffs
triggers.highlight: think about 75% of that related to tariffs

triggers.label: FY guide reaffirmed, EPS ~$2.80
triggers.quote: we are reaffirming our full year guide

triggers.label: CSE margin 'disappointing' on promotions
triggers.quote: Segment operating profit and margin performance was disappointing in the quarter

guidance.quote: we are reaffirming our full year sales outlook of approximately $22 billion with organic growth of flat to low single digits
We expect adjusted EPS of approximately $2.80, up high single digits versus 2025.
we now expect CSAME margins to decline approximately 50 basis points
We expect operating margin of about 17%, a 24% tax rate and about $0.80 of adjusted EPS.
Our current data center backlog now fully covers our expected $1.5 billion of data center sales this year.
expect to deliver a sixth consecutive year of double-digit aftermarket sales growth

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are reaffirming our full year sales outlook of approximately $22 billion
we kept it at $1.5 billion because we have a lot of execution to do in the second half

red_flags.label: CSA movement down 12%, distributor-to-dealer units down 8%
red_flags.quote: Residential sales were down 12%, driven by movements that is the unit volume from distributors to dealers, which was down 8% in the quarter

red_flags.label: Pricing partly tariff-driven and may revert
red_flags.quote: if we get reprieved on the tariffs, the pricing will revert except for the pricing associated with things like the fuel surcharges

red_flags.label: Q1 free cash flow outflow of $15M
red_flags.quote: Free cash flow in the first quarter was a cash outflow of $15 million

evasions.quote: On the residential side, Scott, it's really hard to call a bottom.
What happens with 232, I would be lying if I said I knew. I don't know.
